cues.en: Today, I'm looking at the Tefifon.
cues.zh: 今天我要看看这台Tefifon。

cues.en: The Hujima what? The Tefifon. Now I do have a lot of subscribers in Germany or a lot of viewers anyway. So the Germans amongst you will know exactly what this is or it's more than likely you will but this is pretty much for the rest of you. This device was sold in Germany,
cues.zh: Hu…什么来着？Tefifon。我确实在德国有不少订阅者，或者说不少观众。所以你们当中的德国人一看就知道这是什么，或者说很可能知道，但这主要是讲给其他人听的。这台设备曾在德国销售，

cues.en: imported into The US for a very small period of time but pretty much it's a German device and what is it looking at it? It's pretty hard to make out. It does look a little bit like a set of scales. We've got a plastic section on the right here,
cues.zh: 进口到美国的时间非常短，但基本上它是台德国设备。那它到底是什么呢？光看外表很难辨认。它确实有点像一台秤。右边这里是塑料部分，

cues.en: heavy metal device. You can't pick it up with one hand. The top here is separated out and it's on springs.
cues.zh: 沉重的金属设备。单手都拿不起来。顶部这里是分开的，而且架在弹簧上。

cues.en: Again looks a little bit like a scale from that side. I've got a wheel in the middle here with a rubber band around the outside of it and another one there and then this plastic wheel only turns in one direction. It's got a big weight under it as well which keeps it spinning around. That's on a rubberized mat of sorts. On the right hand side here, we've got a little wheel which moves a thing up in this window here. We've a switch at the top and the bottom. Spin it round round the back. We've got two wires coming out of it
cues.zh: 这边看起来也有点像天平。中间有个轮子，外面套着橡皮筋，那边还有一个，而这个塑料轮只能单向转动。它下面还有个很重的配重，让它一直转下去。这放在某种橡胶垫上。右边这里有个小轮子，能把这个窗口里的东西往上推。上下各有一个开关。转到后面，有两根线伸出来

cues.en: and a socket on the left
cues.zh: 左边有个插座

cues.en: and another socket in the center. Now the two wires are terminated in a euro plug. It runs on 220
cues.zh: 中间还有一个插座。这两根线接到一个欧标插头上。这设备用220

cues.en: volts this device and then this is the audio out because of course the Tefifon is an old piece of HiFi equipment.
cues.zh: 伏电压，然后这里是音频输出，因为Tefifon本来就是老式HiFi设备嘛。

cues.en: The plug easy enough to convert that into The UK one. I can just plug that straight in the wall but this thing that's not going to plug into my HiFi so I'm gonna have to take that apart to get the wires out of it. Couldn't find any kind of converter sockets. I can't find out what that kind of plugs called to be honest. Simple enough though to take it apart. I'm gonna wire it up to one of these RCA
cues.zh: 这个插头很容易转换成英标的。我可以直接把它插到墙上，但这玩意儿插不进我的HiFi设备，所以我得把它拆开，把线取出来。找不到任何转换插座。老实说，我也查不出这种插头叫什么。不过拆开倒挺简单的。我打算把它接到这种RCA

cues.en: phono jack type things.
cues.zh: 唱机插头之类的东西上。

cues.en: It's a mono device the Tefifont. So I've wired those together there.
cues.zh: 这是Tefifont，一台单声道设备。我把它们连在一起了。

cues.en: Solded it on. Pretty simple. I might do a better wiring job than that later on but that was just to get it up and running. Now these are Tefifon
cues.zh: 焊上去了。挺简单的。之后我可能会把线接得更好一些，但这次只是为了让它能跑起来。这些是Tefifon

cues.en: cartridges. I suppose they're called cartridges. I'm not too sure. They're called Tefis.
cues.zh: 卡带。我猜它们叫卡带吧。我不太确定。它们叫Tefis。

cues.en: And we'll just get one out of its slip case here. Cardboard slip case slides out like that.
cues.zh: 我们这就从它的套盒里拿一个出来。纸板套盒像这样滑出来。

cues.en: As you can see quite a chunky thing. It's got a label here to tell you what's on it and on the side also as well at the bottom there notice it says 19 centimeters a second that's how fast it runs at. It's a tape type device. Played by engaging a wheel in this cog here and that little notch keeps it in position on that rubber mat that you saw earlier. All my cartridges are sixty minutes in length of the one which is seventy minutes. These are the smaller size. They do a larger size one which holds up to four hours worth of music.
cues.zh: 如你所见，挺厚实的一个东西。这里有个标签告诉你里面录了什么，侧面底部也注意写着每秒19厘米，这是它的运行速度。它是一种磁带类设备。通过让一个轮子啮合进这里的齿轮来播放，那个小凹口把它固定在之前看到的橡胶垫上的位置。我所有的卡带都是六十分钟长度的，其中一个是七十分钟。这些是较小的尺寸。他们还有更大的尺寸，能容纳长达四小时的音乐。

cues.en: Now this one I'm going show you what's inside it. The reason I'm taking this apart, it teaches Germans how to speak Italian. Not something I'm gonna need. So I've took the screw out of there and let's open up the top and have a look inside. Starting with the lid, you'll see we've got a few bits of felt in there at very strategic positions.
cues.zh: 现在我要给大家看看它里面有什么。我拆开它，是因为它能教德国人说意大利语。这对我来说没什么用。所以我把螺丝拧下来，打开顶部看看里面。从盖子开始，你会看到我们在一些非常关键的位置放了几块毛毡。

cues.en: Presumably to keep the tape moving around smoothly but also maybe to take some fluff and dust off it. I'll explain why that will be important in a second. Now the tape comes out of the center here,
cues.zh: 大概是为了让磁带顺畅地移动，但也许还能去掉一些绒毛和灰尘。我稍后会解释为什么这很重要。现在磁带从这里中心出来，

cues.en: goes around the outside, comes outside the cartridge and then back on the outside with a spool again. I'll pull a little bit out here so you can see it a bit more clearly.
cues.zh: 绕到外面，从卡带外面出来，然后又绕回外面，再次卷到卷轴上。我在这里拉出一点，让你们看得更清楚。

cues.en: Now if you've ever taken apart an eight track cartridge,
cues.zh: 如果你拆过八轨磁带盒，

cues.en: this mechanism will look very familiar to you. And if you haven't, then why not look at my eight track video which I'll point to now. I'll put a link up at the top of the screen. There we go. There. So if you want to look at the eight track video, it's up there.
cues.zh: 这个机制你会觉得非常熟悉。如果你没拆过，那不妨看看我的八轨视频，我现在就指给你。我会在屏幕上方放个链接。好了。在那儿。所以如果你想看八轨视频，就在上面。

cues.en: But the amazing thing about the Tefi cartridges is they're not magnetic tape. This is plastic tape with a groove etched all the way around it from the top to the bottom of that tape. I suppose the nearest point of reference for most people would be a flexi disc that they used to give away magazines many years ago. Imagine one of those stretched out over a very long piece of tape.
cues.zh: 但Tefi磁带盒的神奇之处在于它们不是磁带。这是塑料带，上面从头到尾蚀刻了一圈凹槽。我想对大多数人来说最接近的参照物，就是多年前杂志附赠的那种软唱片。想象一下把那种东西拉长成一条很长的带子。

cues.en: I'll thread it into the machine here, put the cartridge on at the left, turn on the power, you can see the wheel moves around and starts pulling the tape from the top to the bottom.
cues.zh: 我把它穿进这里的机器，把卡带放在左边，打开电源，你可以看到轮子转动起来，开始把磁带从上往下拉。

cues.en: Engage the stylus by putting that down, it dampens this mechanism in on the tape here and the stylus moves on and starts playing at the top and moves its way down to the bottom.
cues.zh: 放下唱针使其接合，它会压住这里的磁带机构，唱针移动起来，从顶部开始播放，一路向下移动。

cues.en: You can adjust the position of the stylus manually by moving this lever here. So for example, if I want go halfway through the recording, move it to the two position there. That puts the stylus roughly halfway down the tape.
cues.zh: 你可以通过移动这里的杠杆手动调整唱针的位置。比如，如果我想跳到录音的中间，就把它移到2的位置，这样唱针就大致落在磁带的中段。

cues.en: Three three quarters and four right at the end. So that's quite a useful way to jump to different tracks that are on this cartridge.
cues.zh: 三又四分之三，最后正好是四。所以这是跳转到卡带上不同音轨的非常实用的方法。

cues.en: Now I'll take the top off this, the plastic top off, so you can get a bit more of an idea as to how this operates inside. It's quite easy. Just remove these two screws off the top.
cues.zh: 现在我把这个顶盖打开，把塑料顶盖取下来，这样你们就能更清楚地了解它内部是如何运作的。很简单，只要拧下顶部这两颗螺丝就行。

cues.en: There we go. This thing's in lovely condition by the way. Absolutely gorgeous. It's like museum quality. I'm very lucky to got hold of this. Anyway, turn on the power. You see it spinning around there. Engage the stylus.
cues.zh: 好了。顺便说一下，这东西状态非常好。简直太美了。简直是博物馆级别的品质。能弄到它我真是太幸运了。总之，打开电源。你看它在那儿转起来了。放下唱针。

cues.en: In fact, let's break out the macro lens and do something a little bit more exciting. So I'll stop this. I think it's time for a macro music montage.
cues.zh: 其实，咱们拿出微距镜头，做点更刺激的事。我先停一下，是时候来一段微距音乐蒙太奇了。

cues.en: Finally, justification for that macro lens. Now on the back of the device you'll have seen this socket and that's got a plug that goes into it here and that's attached to quite a long wire and on the other end of that wire
cues.zh: 终于，微距镜头派上用场了。在设备背面你会看到这个插座，有个插头插在这里，连着一根挺长的线，线的另一端

cues.en: is this.
cues.zh: 是这个。

cues.en: It's remote control. Remember we're talking 1957
cues.zh: 这是遥控器。别忘了，我们说的是1957年

cues.en: and we got a remote control for our HiFi.
cues.zh: 我们的HiFi竟然配了遥控器。

cues.en: It's got forward and back on there and every time you press it it jumps that little needle out with with electric shock almost and then it puts it in a different position.
cues.zh: 上面有前进和后退，每次按下它，那根小针就会弹出来，几乎带着电击，然后它会落到不同的位置。

cues.en: So you can sit back in your chair and jump forward and back at semi random intervals
cues.zh: 所以你可以靠在椅子上，以半随机的间隔前后跳转

cues.en: through the music that you're listening to.
cues.zh: 在你正在听的音乐中。

cues.en: And when you finish listening to your sixty minutes of music, disengage the stylus,
cues.zh: 当你听完六十分钟的音乐后，松开唱针，

cues.en: turn off the power,
cues.zh: 关掉电源，

cues.en: and take the cartridge off the machine,
cues.zh: 把唱头从机器上取下，

cues.en: and feed that red tape back inside there, and put it back inside its cardboard
cues.zh: 把那条红带子收回去，再把它放回纸板

cues.en: cover.
cues.zh: 封套里。

cues.en: Now these are all the different teffees that I've got. A bit of a random selection that came with the machine. I really like that logo by the way. I love logos that describe pretty much what the company does or how it operates.
cues.zh: 这些都是我收集的各种Tefi，随机挑了一些随机器附带的。顺便说一句，我真的很喜欢那个标志。我喜欢那种能大致说明公司做什么或怎么运作的标志。

cues.en: Notice this is from 1955.
cues.zh: 注意，这是1955年的。

cues.en: Now I know that might be copyright but these things are about that age which we're talking 60 years old and they're in absolutely
cues.zh: 我知道这可能有版权问题，但这些大概就是那个年代的，也就是60年前的东西，而且保存得绝对

cues.en: immaculate condition. Here's some of the different box designs I've got and here's some of the different Tefi cartridges
cues.zh: 完好如新。这是我收集的一些不同的盒子设计，还有一些不同的Tefi磁带

cues.en: as well.
cues.zh: 也是。

cues.en: Right. So I think we've played enough Beethoven over tinny speakers.
cues.zh: 好，我觉得用那破喇叭放贝多芬已经放够了。

cues.en: Let's do something different and put some of this easy listening music on which includes vocals and play that back through my proper amplifier and some decent speakers.
cues.zh: 咱们换个花样，放点这种轻松音乐，带人声的，然后用我正经的功放和像样的音箱放出来。

cues.en: Let's have a listen.
cues.zh: 来听听看。

cues.en: Now that was possibly one of the worst cover versions of Tooty Fruity ever. But I'm afraid most of the teffy music is cover versions. They couldn't get any big name artists released on teffy cartridges. But whilst it's playing in the background, just want to show you the difference in size between a Teffi cartridge and an eight track. The reason I keep going back to the eight track cartridges because it uses a very similar idea of a continuous reel of tape that moves from the inside of the reel to the outside of the reel. I know they're vastly different technologies but they are strangely connected as well.
cues.zh: 刚才那可能是史上最烂的Tooty Fruity翻唱版本之一了。但恐怕大多数teffy音乐都是翻唱。他们请不到什么大牌艺人往teffy卡带上发行。不过趁它还在后台放着，我想给你们看看Teffi卡带和八轨带在尺寸上的差别。我一直拿八轨卡带说事儿，是因为它用的思路非常相似——一卷连续的磁带从卷轴内侧往外侧走。我知道这俩技术天差地别，但奇怪的是它们又有着千丝万缕的联系。

cues.en: The wheel that lets you position the stylus anywhere you want on the recording
cues.zh: 让你可以把唱针定位到录音上任意位置的滚轮

cues.en: is very good. It enables you to make very fine movements and get pretty much the track that you want and also it has a protection built in. So if you spin it, it won't scratch the stylus up and down the tape. You have to move the stylus off before you can move it into a different position.
cues.zh: 非常好用。它能让你做非常精细的移动，基本能找到你想要的音轨，而且它还内置了保护机制。所以如果你转动它，它不会让唱针在磁带上上下刮擦。你必须先把唱针移开，才能把它移到不同的位置。

cues.en: My Teffy seem a little bit prone to crackles and pops.
cues.zh: 我的 Teffy 似乎有点容易出现噼啪声和爆音。

cues.en: But then I've got to remember that these recordings are getting on for almost 60 years old and they definitely sound an awful lot better than a 78 RPM record would do. They don't sound as good as a 33. They're a little bit harsh, a little bit thinner. You have to adjust the base up a little bit to give them a richer sound,
cues.zh: 但然后我得记住，这些录音已经快有60年历史了，它们听起来肯定比78转唱片好太多了。它们听起来不如33转的。有点刺耳，有点单薄。你得把低音调高一点，让声音更丰满，

cues.en: but still there's a lot of entertainment to be had from listening to this old machine.
cues.zh: 但还是能从听这台老机器中获得很多乐趣。

cues.en: Anyway,
cues.zh: 总之，

cues.en: that's it for the moment.
cues.zh: 目前就这些。

cues.en: As always,
cues.zh: 一如既往，

cues.en: thanks for watching.
cues.zh: 感谢观看。
